sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report covers CASE-020, a confirmed fraud investigation involving three card-not-present transactions (4012182, 4012183, 4012184) totaling $97.42 in exposure. The initial transaction was flagged by a real-time risk score of 0.88 for a $37.42 domestic purchase [EV-60753040]. Analysis revealed the card SC-03020-K954 had limited prior history (two transactions averaging $30) but showed a burst of three online transactions within 48 hours [EV-e7cdef9a, EV-a68876e4]. The transactions originated from a previously unseen device profile (IOS Device (Apple) unit-caseCASE-020 | synth-os-case-020 | synth-browser-case-020 | synth-screen-case-020) and were routed through an anonymous proxy IP located in Argentina [EV-70da5958, EV-5b3ddf07]. The customer has a prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4325) and the device profile has been observed in another confirmed fraud case [EV-ac08cfd0, EV-328d51bb]. The pattern 'card_not_present_new_device' matches six prior closed cases, indicating a recurring modus operandi [EV-3f35bb25]. The cardholder confirmed they did not authorize the purchases and retain physical possession of the card [EV-ea394a6f]. Based on the convergence of new-device usage, anonymized connectivity, velocity anomalies, and customer dispute, the activity is consistent with card-not-present fraud executed via a compromised credential on a new device.
